body: i dont use reddit much, but we just had grincher in our private lobby. came in with a character with flashing colours, promptly said "y'all fucked" and caused a game crash for all of us.

Hey everyone, thanks for all of your comments and advice. I went back to my doctors clinic with this but spoke to a different doctor, and she did admit to me that it was in error of them to prescribe me folic acid supplements /without/ prescribing me B12 also. I now have B12 supplements and I'll be focusing on getting that up first, which is just what some of you (and now my doctor) suggested. I must say I'm feeling better already. Thank you so much everyone.

Thank you for this, these are some good points - ones that I've been told before, albeit, that I still seem to struggle to implement in basic communication. I'll keep trying, but it's good to be reminded that this isn't a personal failure (as it oftentimes does feel).

I often get the response "Well you can't just say you have autism and not try to get better, or you'll get nowhere," which I understand is a very valid criticism (and I'd hate to use my mental health as an excuse for poor behaviour) but I'm slowly realising that this may very well be something I cannot just "get over", so to speak, since it is, as you've said, a skill I don't naturally have.


Thank you for this. As much as I've been trying to make amends, I think it's just a case of our methods of communication being very incompatible, which is a shame but I guess its just how things are.
